sys_atf_test.description: Validates SnackFlow Invoice Payment Rollup (after insert/update/delete, order 100) on a purpose-created invoice totalling 10500. Asserts a first payment of 4000 yields amount_paid 4000 / balance_due 6500 / partially_paid; a second payment of 6500 clears it to balance_due 0 / paid; and deleting that second payment re-derives 4000 / 6500 / partially_paid, proving the rollup is a full re-sum rather than an increment. Also asserts the invoice is counted in outstanding receivables only while a balance remains.
sys_atf_test.name: SnackFlow: payment rollup, balance due and paid/partially-paid transitions
